objective: Stage 4 plan 4.3a. The adapter exports the tracked and untracked-not-ignored files to a fresh temporary directory (never .git, never an ignored file), runs Codex there, and copies back only changes inside the write grants; anything else refuses the whole copy-back and the real tree stays byte-identical. This makes the write scope preventative. Reads by absolute path stay open until container or VM isolation, so D4 is not retired.
